title: This Free AI Assistant Actually Does Things
sources: GitHub, openclaw/openclaw (README, checked 2026-11-17): 394,618 stars, created 2025-11-24, MIT; 'The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform.'; runs on your own computer; channels Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp and 20+ more; native apps macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, Linux; state, memory and credentials live on your hardware; models (Claude, Codex, local) are swappable plugins; no paid tier, hosted service or token; stewarded by the OpenClaw Foundation, a 501(c)(3); one-line installer for macOS, Linux, Windows; tools run on the host unless sandboxing is configured. Images: README banner, docs/whatsapp-openclaw.jpg, macOS onboarding screenshots, app and channel icons from the repo.

lines.text: Imagine texting your AI on WhatsApp, and it actually does the work for you.
lines.caps: Texting your AI | on *WhatsApp, | and it *actually | does the *work.

lines.text: That's OpenClaw, a free, open-source AI assistant with nearly four hundred thousand stars on GitHub.
It runs on your own computer, not someone else's cloud.
lines.caps: It runs on | *your computer, | not someone's *cloud.

lines.text: And it meets you where you already chat: WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, iMessage, and twenty more.
lines.caps: It meets you | where you *chat: | *WhatsApp, | *Telegram, | *Slack, | *Discord, | *iMessage, | and *20 more.

lines.text: Its memory and your logins stay on your own hardware.
lines.caps: Its *memory | and your *logins | stay on *your hardware.

lines.text: Pick the brain: Claude, Codex, or a local model, and swap it anytime.
lines.caps: Pick the *brain: | *Claude, | *Codex, | or a *local model, | *swap it anytime.

lines.text: There's no paid tier, no hosted service, and no crypto token. A non-profit foundation runs it.
lines.caps: No *paid tier, | no *hosted service, | no *token. | A *non-profit | runs it.

lines.text: Install it on Mac, Windows or Linux with one command.
Just remember: it can run tools on your machine, so read the security guide first.
lines.caps: Just *remember: | it runs *tools | on your *machine, | read the *security guide.

lines.text: Would you let an AI run your computer? Tell me in the comments.
lines.caps: Would you let | an AI run | your *computer? | Tell me in the *comments.
